description: This file handles the display and processing of the detailed view of a 'Role' entity within the SuiteCRM system. It manages user authorization, retrieves role data, sets up template variables, and renders the detail view, including subpanels and module assignment interfaces.

classes.description: Class managing the module assignment interface for roles.
